final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT cr.raceId, c.country, SUM(cr.points) as total_points, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_count FROM step1), step3_min AS (SELECT MIN(record_count) as min_top10 FROM (SELECT record_count FROM step1 ORDER BY record_count DESC LIMIT 10)) SELECT step1.raceId, step1.country, step1.total_points, step1.record_count, step1.record_count - step2.avg_count as difference FROM step1, step2, step3_min WHERE step1.record_count > step2.avg_count AND step1.record_count >= step3_min.min_top10 ORDER BY difference DESC
